definitions.explanation: Something that is said or stated, especially in a formal or public context such as meetings or interviews.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}で{発言|はつげん}する{機会|きかい}がなかった。
examples.english: I didn't have a chance to speak at the meeting.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{発言|はつげん}が{問題|もんだい}になった。
{発言|はつげん}を{撤回|てっかい}する。

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {発言|はつげん}する (to make a statement, to speak)
- {発言|はつげん}を{求|もと}める (to call for comments)
- {発言|はつげん}を{撤回|てっかい}する (to retract a statement)
- {問題|もんだい}{発言|はつげん} (problematic statement)
- {発言|はつげん}{権|けん} (right to speak)

RELATED TERMS:
- コメント - comment
- {意見|いけん} - opinion
- {発表|はっぴょう} - announcement
